facts.value: Qualifies left-stick input when either absolute axis is >= common x494 and immediately returns ftCo_8009AAFC's result with arg1=true. A false result does not permit C-stick fallback. Only unqualified left input permits the identical inclusive C-stick test and helper dispatch with arg1=false. Neither qualifying writes cliff.x8=true and returns false. True denotes a dispatched climb or Fall transition; false does not prevent subsequent CliffWait timeout handling.
facts.rationale: Corrects whole-dispatcher state persistence and records inclusive source priority.

facts.value: With T=x20_radians and P=stick_x*facing_dir, the sector is angle>T || (angle>-T && P>=0). Inside it, arg1 && cliff.x8 dispatches ftCo_8009AB9C and true; otherwise false without release fallback. Outside it, x8 permits a common ledge-cooldown write followed by Fall and true; otherwise false. No local clear of x8 occurs. For positive finite T, -T is outside and +T requires P>=0. Signed zero P passes; unordered angle/T comparisons fail both sector arms under ordinary floating semantics. No finite-value checks exist.
facts.rationale: Replaces approximate angular prose with exact guards and boundary behavior.

evidence.why: Exact predicate and all return paths.

facts.value: Selects CliffClimbQuick for damage<x488 and Slow otherwise, including equality. Calls Fighter_ChangeMotionState(gobj,msid,Ft_MF_None,0,1,0,NULL), ftAnim_8006EBA4, ftCommon_8007E2F4(fp,32), sets x221D_b7 and x221D_b5 true, then calls ftCo_CliffCatch_Phys. Both active climb table entries bind the four owned callbacks. Anim completion calls ftCommon_8007D92C, choosing Fall for GA_Air and ft_8008A2BC otherwise; physics or collision can cause earlier exits.
facts.rationale: Repairs unconditional grounded completion without assigning unsupported meanings to bits or arguments.

facts.value: Reads ground_or_air through gobj->user_data. For GA_Air, ft_800821DC(gobj) true invokes ftCo_8009AE14(gobj), which forwards user_data to ftCommon_8007D7FC. Only a false primary result permits ftCo_8009EF68(gobj), which tests Collide_CeilingHug and can enter StopCeil. The false boolean is not forwarded as an argument. Initial non-air states call ft_80084104(gobj). Returns void and performs no direct Fighter field writes.
facts.rationale: Repairs literal boolean-forwarding ambiguity while keeping unverified query side effects separate.

facts.value: Initial non-air states call ft_80084FA8. GA_Air uses mpLib_80054ED8: -1 or disabled/hidden lines return false and cause Fall without a local cooldown write; other out-of-range IDs report and loop. On true, facing>0 selects the previous-floor-chain v0 endpoint helper, otherwise the next-floor-chain v1 helper. Writes x=transNPos.z*facing+endpoint.x and y=endpoint.y+transNPos.y, not z. If still airborne and translation z and y are both >=0, copies the original ledge ID to floor.index and calls grounding, which can assert on failed floor validation. Zero offsets qualify; NaNs fail guards after arithmetic. Translation provenance and chain well-formedness remain external.
facts.rationale: Corrects validation, facing, and airborne-duration overclaims.

facts.value: Neither stick qualifying arms cliff.x8. Qualified left input has priority and can select climb or cooldown-bearing release; qualified C-stick input can select release but not climb. Climb selects Quick for damage<x488 and Slow otherwise. Anim completion chooses Fall for GA_Air and ft_8008A2BC otherwise; IASA is empty. Physics positions relative to a facing-selected floor-chain endpoint and requests grounding when both translation offsets are nonnegative. False line validation enters Fall, but malformed IDs other than -1 can loop. Collision gives its primary-query success wrapper priority over ceiling-hug handling.
facts.rationale: Repairs TU-wide unconditional grounded completion and blanket geometry fallback.
